compound.description: Replication lag AND readonly replicas both firing at once — a stronger signal of a stuck/diverging replica than either metric alone.
compound.title: Replica Split-Brain Risk

compound.description: Stuck merges AND high disk usage both firing at once — merges are likely stalled fighting for disk headroom rather than transient load.
compound.title: Merge Pressure

commonCauses: ZooKeeper / ClickHouse Keeper unavailable or laggy
Replica metadata corruption (force_restore_data required)
Disk full on the replica
rules.description: Replicas in read-only mode cannot accept writes.
rules.sql:
SELECT count() AS readonly_count
FROM system.replicas
WHERE is_readonly = 1
rules.title: Readonly Replicas

commonCauses: Slow network or saturated inter-server connections
Large fetch backlog in `replication_queue`
ZooKeeper / Keeper latency
rules.description: Maximum absolute_delay across all replicas (seconds behind leader).

fix.description: Replicas ordered by absolute_delay, worst first.
fix.label: Get lagging replicas
fix.sql:
SELECT database, table, replica_name, absolute_delay, is_readonly
FROM system.replicas
ORDER BY absolute_delay DESC
LIMIT 20

rules.sql:
SELECT max(absolute_delay) AS max_lag
FROM system.replicas
rules.title: Replication Lag

rules.description: Worst-case disk utilization across all configured volumes.
rules.sql:
SELECT round(max((total_space - free_space) * 100.0 / nullIf(total_space, 0)), 1) AS disk_percent
FROM system.disks
rules.title: Disk Usage

rules.description: Recent KEEPER_EXCEPTION events. Sustained exceptions indicate quorum issues.
rules.sql:
SELECT coalesce(max(value) - min(value), 0) AS exception_count
FROM merge('system', '^error_log')
WHERE error = 'KEEPER_EXCEPTION'
  AND event_time > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
rules.title: Keeper Exceptions

commonCauses: Mutation references a column that no longer exists
Disk full on a replica preventing part writes
Hardware / network fault during part rewrite
rules.description: Mutations that are not complete and have recorded a failure. Failed mutations block subsequent mutations on the same table.

fix.description: Incomplete mutations with a recorded failure.
fix.label: Get failed mutations
fix.sql:
SELECT database, table, mutation_id, command, latest_fail_reason, latest_fail_time
FROM system.mutations
WHERE is_done = 0 AND latest_fail_reason != ''
ORDER BY latest_fail_time DESC
LIMIT 20

rules.sql:
SELECT countIf(is_done = 0 AND latest_fail_reason != '') AS failed_count
FROM system.mutations
rules.title: Failed Mutations

commonCauses: Very large parts requiring many hours to merge
Disk I/O saturation or slow storage
Insufficient background_pool_size
rules.description: Merges running for more than 10 minutes. Stuck merges block table inserts and consume resources.

fix.description: Merges running longer than 10 minutes, slowest first.
fix.label: Get stuck merges
fix.sql:
SELECT database, table, elapsed, progress, num_parts, total_size_bytes_compressed
FROM system.merges
WHERE elapsed > 600
ORDER BY elapsed DESC
LIMIT 20

rules.sql:
SELECT count() AS stuck_count
FROM system.merges
WHERE elapsed > 600
rules.title: Stuck Merges

commonCauses: max_execution_time set too low for heavy analytical queries
Missing sort key for the filter predicate
Cross-shard queries without proper distribution settings
rules.description: Queries killed due to timeout (TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED) in the last hour.
rules.sql:
SELECT count() AS timeout_count
FROM system.query_log
WHERE event_time > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  AND type IN ('ExceptionWhileProcessing', 'ExceptionBeforeStart')
  AND (exception_code = 159 OR exception LIKE '%TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED%')
rules.title: Query Timeout Breaches (1h)

commonCauses: Remote storage unavailable or credentials expired
Disk full on backup destination
Network interruption during backup transfer
rules.description: Backup operations that ended in FAILED status in the last 24 hours.
rules.sql:
SELECT count() AS failed_count
FROM system.backup_log
WHERE event_time > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND status IN ('BACKUP_FAILED', 'RESTORE_FAILED')
rules.title: Failed Backups (24h)

commonCauses: Source table schema changed incompatibly
MV query references a missing table or column
Resource exhaustion during refresh
rules.description: Materialized views with REFRESH schedule that have failed or errored their last refresh cycle.
rules.sql:
SELECT countIf(exception != '' OR retry > 0) AS failed_count
FROM system.view_refreshes
rules.title: MV Refresh Failures

commonCauses: Frequent small inserts producing parts faster than merges consume them
Background merges starved (low background_pool_size, slow disk)
Partition key too granular, spreading inserts across many partitions
`parts_to_throw_insert` / `parts_to_delay_insert` lowered per table
rules.description: Worst partition’s active parts as a percentage of parts_to_throw_insert. A predictive "too many parts" signal — sustained pressure leads to throttled then rejected inserts.

fix.description: Partitions with the most active parts, worst first.
fix.label: Get partitions near the throw limit
fix.sql:
SELECT database, table, partition, count() AS parts
FROM system.parts
WHERE active
GROUP BY database, table, partition
ORDER BY parts DESC
LIMIT 20

rules.sql:
WITH parts_now AS (
    SELECT database, table, partition, count() AS parts
    FROM system.parts
    WHERE active AND database NOT IN ('system', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'information_schema')
    GROUP BY database, table, partition
  ),
  table_overrides AS (
    SELECT
      database,
      name AS table,
      toInt64OrZero(extract(replaceRegexpOne(
      replaceRegexpAll(create_table_query, '\\x27(?:[^\\x27\\\\]|\\\\.)*\\x27', ''),
      '(?s)^.*\\sSETTINGS\\s+',
      ''
    ), '(?:^|,)\\s*parts_to_throw_insert\\s*=\\s*([0-9]+)')) AS throw_override,
      toInt64OrZero(extract(replaceRegexpOne(
      replaceRegexpAll(create_table_query, '\\x27(?:[^\\x27\\\\]|\\\\.)*\\x27', ''),
      '(?s)^.*\\sSETTINGS\\s+',
      ''
    ), '(?:^|,)\\s*parts_to_delay_insert\\s*=\\s*([0-9]+)')) AS delay_override
    FROM system.tables
    WHERE database IN (SELECT name FROM system.databases WHERE engine IN ('Atomic', 'Lazy', 'Memory', 'Ordinary', 'Replicated', 'Shared'))
      AND database NOT IN ('system', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'information_schema')
      AND (database, name) IN (SELECT database, table FROM parts_now)
  ),
  server_defaults AS (
    SELECT
      coalesce((SELECT toInt64OrNull(value) FROM system.merge_tree_settings WHERE name = 'parts_to_throw_insert'), 3000) AS throw_default,
      coalesce((SELECT toInt64OrNull(value) FROM system.merge_tree_settings WHERE name = 'parts_to_delay_insert'), 1000) AS delay_default
  ),
  limits AS (
    SELECT
      p.database AS database,
      p.table AS table,
      p.partition AS partition,
      p.parts AS parts,
      if(o.throw_override > 0, o.throw_override, (SELECT throw_default FROM server_defaults)) AS throw_limit,
      if(o.delay_override > 0, o.delay_override, (SELECT delay_default FROM server_defaults)) AS delay_limit
    FROM parts_now p
    LEFT JOIN table_overrides o ON p.database = o.database AND p.table = o.table
    WHERE p.parts >= 20
  )
SELECT round(max(parts * 100.0 / nullIf(throw_limit, 0)), 1) AS pressure_percent
FROM limits
rules.title: Parts Pressure

commonCauses: PARTITION BY too granular (hourly or high-cardinality keys)
Time-series table with no table-level TTL, so old partitions never drop
Inserts producing parts faster than background merges consume them
rules.description: MergeTree tables with partition bloat, a time-based PARTITION BY and no table TTL, or a merge backlog. Recommend-only — never applies ALTER TTL or DROP PARTITION.

fix.description: MergeTree-family tables with the most active partitions, worst first.
fix.label: Get tables with 500+ partitions
fix.sql:
SELECT
  concat(database, '.', table) AS full_table,
  uniqExact(partition) AS partitions,
  count() AS active_parts
FROM system.parts
WHERE active
GROUP BY database, table
HAVING partitions >= 500
ORDER BY partitions DESC
LIMIT 20

rules.sql:
WITH mergetree_tables AS (
      SELECT
        database,
        name,
        engine,
        partition_key,
        engine_full
      FROM system.tables
      WHERE is_temporary = 0
        AND database IN (SELECT name FROM system.databases WHERE engine IN ('Atomic', 'Lazy', 'Memory', 'Ordinary', 'Replicated', 'Shared'))
        AND database NOT IN ('system', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'information_schema')
        AND positionCaseInsensitive(engine, 'MergeTree') > 0
    ),
    part_stats AS (
      SELECT
        database,
        table,
        uniqExact(partition) AS partitions,
        count() AS active_parts,
        if(
          uniqExact(partition) = 0,
          0,
          round(count() / uniqExact(partition), 2)
        ) AS parts_per_partition,
        sum(bytes_on_disk) AS bytes_on_disk,
        sum(rows) AS rows
      FROM system.parts
      WHERE active
        AND database NOT IN ('system', 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'information_schema')
      GROUP BY database, table
    ),
    inventory AS (
      SELECT
        t.database,
        t.name AS table,
        concat(t.database, '.', t.name) AS full_table,
        t.database AS _database,
        t.name AS _table,
        t.engine,
        t.partition_key,
        
      if(
        positionCaseInsensitive(t.engine_full, ' TTL ') > 0,
        trim(BOTH ' ' FROM replaceRegexpOne(
          substring(
            t.engine_full,
            positionCaseInsensitive(t.engine_full, ' TTL ') + 5
          ),
          '\\s+SETTINGS\\s+.*$',
          ''
        )),
        ''
      ) AS ttl_expression,
        
      multiIf(
        ifNull(p.partitions, 0) >= 1000,
          'Rebuild with coarser PARTITION BY',
        ifNull(p.partitions, 0) >= 500,
          'Consider monthly partitions',
        (
        positionCaseInsensitive(t.partition_key, 'toYYYYMM') > 0
        OR positionCaseInsensitive(t.partition_key, 'toStartOf') > 0
        OR positionCaseInsensitive(t.partition_key, 'toDate') > 0
        OR positionCaseInsensitive(t.partition_key, 'toMonday') > 0
        OR positionCaseInsensitive(t.partition_key, 'toYearWeek') > 0
        OR positionCaseInsensitive(t.partition_key, 'toISOWeek') > 0
      )
          AND positionCaseInsensitive(t.engine_full, ' TTL ') = 0,
          'Add table TTL',
        ifNull(p.partitions, 0) > 0
          AND ifNull(p.active_parts, 0) / ifNull(p.partitions, 1)
            >= 10,
          'Check merge backlog',
        ''
      ) AS recommendation,
        ifNull(p.partitions, 0) AS partitions,
        ifNull(p.active_parts, 0) AS active_parts,
        ifNull(p.parts_per_partition, 0) AS parts_per_partition,
        ifNull(p.bytes_on_disk, 0) AS bytes_on_disk,
        ifNull(p.rows, 0) AS rows
      FROM mergetree_tables AS t
      LEFT JOIN part_stats AS p
        ON p.database = t.database AND p.table = t.name
    )
SELECT count() AS flagged_count
FROM inventory
WHERE recommendation != ''
rules.title: TTL & Partition Health

rules.description: Replication queue entries retried more than 100 times or queued for over an hour. A stuck entry stops the replica from catching up and grows replication lag.

fix.description: Oldest queue entries with their retry count and last exception. Fix the cause in last_exception (missing part, disk, Keeper), then let the queue retry.
fix.label: Get stuck queue entries
fix.sql:
SELECT database, table, type, create_time, num_tries, last_exception, postpone_reason
FROM system.replication_queue
WHERE num_tries > 100 OR create_time < now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
ORDER BY create_time ASC
LIMIT 20

rules.sql:
SELECT count() AS stuck_count
FROM system.replication_queue
WHERE num_tries > 100 OR create_time < now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
rules.title: Stuck Replication Queue

rules.description: Replicated tables whose ZooKeeper/Keeper session has expired. These tables are read-only until the session is re-established — check Keeper health and network to the Keeper ensemble.

fix.description: Replicated tables whose Keeper session has expired.
fix.label: Get replicas with an expired session
fix.sql:
SELECT database, table, replica_name, is_readonly, zookeeper_path
FROM system.replicas
WHERE is_session_expired
LIMIT 20

rules.sql:
SELECT countIf(is_session_expired) AS expired_count
FROM system.replicas
rules.title: Replica Keeper Session Expired

commonCauses: Too-small batches producing many parts (recommend ≥ 1000 rows / insert)
Background merges starved (low background pool size, slow disk)
`parts_to_delay_insert` / `parts_to_throw_insert` tuned too low
rules.description: INSERTs currently throttled because a partition exceeded parts_to_delay_insert. Merges are falling behind inserts — batch inserts into fewer, larger blocks or coarsen PARTITION BY.

fix.description: DelayedInserts is a global gauge. These partitions carry the most active parts — the likely cause of the throttling.
fix.label: Get partitions with the most parts
fix.sql:
SELECT database, table, partition, count() AS parts
FROM system.parts
WHERE active
GROUP BY database, table, partition
ORDER BY parts DESC
LIMIT 20

rules.sql:
SELECT value AS delayed_inserts
FROM system.metrics
WHERE metric = 'DelayedInserts'
rules.title: Delayed Inserts

rules.description: INSERTs rejected with TOO_MANY_PARTS in the last hour. Data was not written — the client must retry. Reduce insert frequency or coarsen PARTITION BY.
rules.sql:
SELECT count() AS rejected_count
FROM system.query_log
WHERE event_time > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  AND type IN ('ExceptionBeforeStart', 'ExceptionWhileProcessing')
  AND exception_code = 252
rules.title: Rejected Inserts (1h)

rules.description: Server memory tracked by ClickHouse (MemoryTracking) as a percentage of host RAM (OSMemoryTotal). Near 100% queries fail with MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED — find the heaviest queries and cap max_memory_usage.

fix.description: Running queries using the most memory right now.
fix.label: Get top queries by memory
fix.sql:
SELECT query_id, user, elapsed, formatReadableSize(memory_usage) AS memory, substring(query, 1, 200) AS query
FROM system.processes
ORDER BY memory_usage DESC
LIMIT 20

rules.sql:
SELECT round(
  (SELECT value FROM system.metrics WHERE metric = 'MemoryTracking') * 100.0
  / nullIf((SELECT value FROM system.asynchronous_metrics WHERE metric = 'OSMemoryTotal'), 0),
  1
) AS memory_percent
rules.title: Memory Pressure

rules.description: Parts ClickHouse detached because they were broken (checksum mismatch, corruption, unexpected files). On a replica the data is usually refetched; on a non-replicated table it may be lost — inspect before dropping.

fix.description: Detached parts whose reason starts with "broken".
fix.label: Get broken detached parts
fix.sql:
SELECT database, table, name, reason
FROM system.detached_parts
WHERE reason LIKE 'broken%'
ORDER BY database, table, name
LIMIT 50

rules.sql:
SELECT count() AS broken_count
FROM system.detached_parts
WHERE reason LIKE 'broken%'
rules.title: Broken Detached Parts

rules.description: Fatal errors in the server text log in the last hour.
rules.sql:
SELECT count() AS fatal_count
FROM system.text_log
WHERE level = 'Fatal'
  AND event_time >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
rules.title: Fatal Log Entries
